top_signals.title: Iran Rules Out Return of UN Nuclear Inspectors as U.S. War Talks Stall
top_signals.summary: Iran continues to divert attempts by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) to access and verify the Iranian stockpile of enriched uranium and rules out any engagement with the UN’s agency’s inspectors amid the standoff in the war with the U.S. “It is more than a year since the agency lost continuity of knowledge in relation to the previously declared inventories of highly-enriched uranium,” IAEA Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi wrote in a restricted report, which was circulated in Vienna on Friday and was seen…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
